summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the start of commissioning of its Serra Sul +20 project, a long-distance conveyor belt expansion at its S11D iron ore operation in Brazil. The project, part of the Novo Carajás Program, is expected to add 20 Mtpy of production capacity and enhance operational flexibility. No financial terms, transaction structure, or special-situation event (merger, tender, restructuring, etc.) is involved. This is a routine operational update by a foreign private issuer regarding capital projects, with no M&A or corporate action implications.
